provenance.expected_applying: BRUTE FORCE: step both bodies forward by dt and compare the orb. True=shrinking, False=growing, None=UNCHANGED (no direction). Never read from core.astro.aspects.
provenance.angle_source: the five Ptolemaic angles; a hard-coded literal set, not imported from the project
provenance.why_not_project_derived: a fixture generated from the implementation under test would be tautological; every expected value here is computed independently
provenance.generation_is_offline: pure arithmetic in longitudes; no ephemeris, no network, no database
provenance.equal_longitude_grid: W1-5b: the first 875 vectors never place the two bodies at the same longitude, because a random or evenly spaced float grid does not land on equality. There the separation is a local MINIMUM and the sign rule needs its own branch. The grid appended at the end is explicit about it.
